Playbook.name: Defender — High-Confidence Endpoint/Identity/Office Attack Alert - SOC Playbook

ExecutiveSummary.Overview: Defender for Endpoint/Identity/Office raised a non-informational, unresolved alert (excluding nessus) - a high-confidence native detection. Triage per the alert's title/tactic: confirm the attack and its scope.
ExecutiveSummary.BusinessImpact: Defender high-confidence alerts surface real endpoint/identity/office attacks warranting SOC action.

TelemetryRequirements.Requirement: Defender XDR alerts via Elastic Agent (verified live). Fields: m365_defender.alert.detection_source, .severity, .status, .title, .category, threat.tactic.name, user.name, host.name, m365_defender.alert.evidence.device_dns_name. INGEST LAG ~26 min - 4h windows + event.ingested override.

Signal.Name: High-Confidence Endpoint/Identity/Office
Signal.Details: Defender alert (MDE/MDI/MDO), severity != informational, status != resolved.

InitialAssessment.Rule: Weigh the full evidence story per the ClassificationGuidance, not any single fact.

Investigation.Goal: Confirm the Defender-detected attack, its tactic and scope, and whether it is a true incident.

Step.name: Read the Defender alert(s) for this host/user
Step.Purpose: The alert title, tactic, detection source and severity define the attack and investigation path.
Step.Query: FROM logs-m365_defender.alert* | WHERE m365_defender.alert.detection_source IN ("microsoftDefenderForEndpoint","microsoftDefenderForIdentity","microsoftDefenderForOffice365") AND m365_defender.alert.severity != "informational" AND (host.name == "$host" OR user.name == "$user") AND @timestamp >= NOW() - 4 hours | KEEP @timestamp, m365_defender.alert.title, m365_defender.alert.severity, m365_defender.alert.detection_source, threat.tactic.name, user.name, host.name | SORT @timestamp DESC | LIMIT 25
Step.AnalystNotes: Read the title and tactic. Credential Access/Lateral Movement/Exfiltration tactics on a sensitive host/user are high priority. Detection source tells you the surface (endpoint/identity/office).

Step.name: Other Defender alerts on the same host/user (scope)
Step.Purpose: Multiple alerts across tactics on one entity indicate a real multi-stage incident.
Step.Query: FROM logs-m365_defender.alert* | WHERE (host.name == "$host" OR user.name == "$user") AND @timestamp >= NOW() - 4 hours | KEEP @timestamp, m365_defender.alert.title, threat.tactic.name, m365_defender.alert.detection_source | SORT @timestamp DESC | LIMIT 25
Step.AnalystNotes: Several alerts across tactics (e.g. Initial Access then Credential Access then Lateral Movement) on one host/user = a real intrusion - escalate.

Node.Condition: Defender alert(s) confirm an attack (credential access/lateral/exfil) on a sensitive host/user, especially multiple tactics.
Node.Result: True Positive (Confirmed Attack - IR per tactic)

Node.Condition: A known-benign/expected alert type that is tuned in Defender but promoted here.

DocumentationChecklist.Item: Attach outputs of INV-01-DEF-ALERT, INV-02-DEF-SCOPE to the case.

FalsePositive.Definition: A benign/expected alert or a tuned Defender detection.

SOCAction.Item: Confirm benign; tune in Defender; close.
Follow the tactic-appropriate IR (isolate host / reset user); pull Defender timeline; open IR.

Phase.name: Immediate Actions (0-30 minutes)
Phase.Action: Read the Defender alert; follow the tactic-appropriate response.
Isolate host / reset user per the alert.

Phase.name: Containment and Eradication (hours)
Phase.Action: Isolate host / reset user; pull the Defender timeline; open IR.
Scope across the entity's other alerts.

Phase.name: Recovery and Hardening (days)
Phase.Action: Ensure Defender is enforcing; tune benign categories in Defender; integrate the Defender timeline into IR.

QualityChecks.Check: Defender ingest lag ~26 min - 4h window + event.ingested override. detection_source distinguishes the protection surface.

TruePositiveClosure.Item: Attack scoped and contained per tactic; Defender timeline retained.
